presentation.finding: The continuation model called show_document_set, but _planned_calls inserted each new call ID into the shared seen_call_ids set before LibraryToolScope.defer checked that same set. defer therefore discarded the new client call before finish_workspace_turn could deliver it.

group_voice.finding: Panel turns create no private PersonaMessage row. commit_library_message still invokes persist_guard, which updates the expert-turn lease, then returns for row=None without committing. The open write transaction spans model/tool work and the separate workspace operation fails with SQLite database is locked before find_documents reaches its handler.

mode.finding: Structured active document-set state was present, but mode remained model-authored. Text selected replace/filter/extend correctly; Voice changed the filter follow-up to replace, broadening the result to all 20 documents.
